components.text: Aeronautics engines: propellers (wood, andesite, smart, propeller bearing), hot air and steam. Pack config defaults hotAirStrength and steamStrength to 1.5 kpg per m³. Burner and steam valve have caps.$(br)$(br)✎ A potato cannon on a ship has recoil — do not mount it on the rail without a plan.
I will not draft a bridge block-for-block. Aeronautics moves its layouts. Use EMI and your first raft. Create stress still applies on a ship — Mechanist was right.
